name: 12th Ward Park | Hazleton, PA
paragraphs: 12th Ward Park in Hazleton received a full playground and site upgrade under our scope of work, including new play equipment set on a safety surface, walkways, and a fenced multi-sport court.
Our team handled the site grading, surfacing, and fencing that ties the park's different areas together, giving the neighborhood a modern, safe recreational space for kids and families.
summary: New playground, sports court, and site work.
